productDetails.longDescription:
What it is: An on-the-go cream blush that wakes up cheeks and lips with a satiny, diffused flush.


Finish: Satin


Formulation: Cream


Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: Pocket Blush is a lightweight cream blush that melts on smoothly, blends seamlessly, and stays all day. It hydrates skin for baby-soft cheeks and leaves a glowy finish without a greasy feel. 


Clinical Results: Based on a 32-subject consumer perception study after 2 weeks of use:

-100% said it gave cheeks a natural glow

-97% said it melts into skin + blends seamlessly

-3 out of 4 said the blush feels hydrating


Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is our commitment to offering effective products without certain ingredients, such as parabens, sulfates, phthalates, and mineral oils. Learn more here.
productDetails.shortDescription:
What it is: An on-the-go cream blush that wakes up cheeks and lips with a satiny, diffused flush.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: Pocket Blush is a lightweight cream blush that melts on smoothly, blends seamlessly, and stays all day. It hydrates skin for baby-soft cheeks and leaves a glowy finish without a greasy feel.
productDetails.suggestedUsage:
Suggested Usage:
-Apply with your finger or a brush and tap onto cheeks.
-Color is buildable, so tap on a little or a lot—however you like it.
-For a monochromatic look, apply to cheeks and lips.
-Avoid the eye area.

itemReviewed.name: Pocket Blush Buildable Hydrating Cream Blush

reviews.name: Great color but
reviews.description: I love this pink blush because it's subtle, buildable, and a great size. However, I've run into a major packaging issue. Even when the product is rolled all the way down, the slightest bit of warmth causes the blush to slip out of the tube and melt all over the inside of the cap. It’s not a deal breaker but it is annoying

itemReviewed.name: Pocket Blush Buildable Hydrating Cream Blush

reviews.name: Love the formula and the shade range!
reviews.description: I absolutely adore this formula!! It blends so easily and a little goes a long way on my light-medium skin. Piggy looked really cool toned when I swatched it on my hand, so I was pleasantly surprised by how much I enjoyed how it looked on my face! I have tried lots of other cream blush formulas from Sephora and I keep coming back to Rhode! I  also love combining different shades of the pocket blushes to create a custom look!

itemReviewed.name: Pocket Blush Buildable Hydrating Cream Blush

reviews.name: Great beginner blush
reviews.description: Pleasantly surprised by this product, great muted color, medium to full pigmentation depending on application. I find the best way to use is with a brush and set with setting spray before powder, otherwise it will fade. I find myself reaching for this blush nearly everyday.

itemReviewed.name: Pocket Blush Buildable Hydrating Cream Blush

reviews.name: NOT WORTH TIKTOK HYPE! GAVE ME ACNE!
reviews.description: I was using the pocket blushes for about a year, when I realized that it was causing me cystic acne and closed commodores all over my cheeks. as someone who doesn’t really struggle with acne and hasn’t in the past, I was really confused on what was making me break out so I continued to use the pocket blushes. The acne would only show up in the places that I applied the pocket blushes and it was always right after I wore the blush.  The blending of these products isn’t even good, they pill off your face. They don’t stay on for very long at all, and they separate on top of other makeup. i’m really frustrated that I spent money to essentially break out my face every time I wear this blush.

itemReviewed.name: Pocket Blush Buildable Hydrating Cream Blush

reviews.name: It girl blush!
reviews.description: So excited to finally try this cute blush:) Really like the texture and it’s not super dewy or greasy, but it gives you a perfect glow. The only downside is not super long lasting.

itemReviewed.name: Pocket Blush Buildable Hydrating Cream Blush

reviews.description: gorgeous color but absolutely not long wearing on oily skin girls. it has a beautiful glow but fades really easily. also as a true neutral golden girl, i do feel it pulls slightly cool even baby pink on me.

reviews.description: After using this product everyday, my skin feels hydrated rather than caked and looks amazing. I love this color and the name!!

itemReviewed.name: Pocket Blush Buildable Hydrating Cream Blush

itemReviewed.name: Pocket Blush Buildable Hydrating Cream Blush

reviews.description: The shade candy apply is a warm tone red blush with some pearl to it and it’s perfect for that natural flushed look. I do own 3 other shades of these blushes since I do like the formula and colors that they offer. These blushes are blendable, easy to apply, and look stunning on the skin. I just want to note that these blushes are so creamy that I have to layer it with a powder blush to make sure the color lasts on my cheeks throughout the day because I have oily skin.
